title.narrative: Association Malienne pour la Promotion de la Jeune Fille et de la Femme (AMPJF)

description.narrative: "AMPJF works to:-Ensure effective education for girls and women in Mali;-Create a re ensuring the well-being and development of girls and women;-Help girls and women to fully play their roles in the life of the city.The Equality Fund grant will be used to finance part of the operating costs.This grant also supports:-Financing AMPJF's operational and organizational expenses (salaries,rent, equipment, meetings of the members' council and staff training and administrativecosts)-Promoting young women's leadership through capacity building inassociative dynamics, networking and partnership development, rights andcitizenship-Capacity building for youth groups and organizations in theold and new areas-Organizing public events (demonstrations, lobbying, mobilizations)led by activists, young women and girls leaders"
